chapters.about: standing before Hashem on Yom HaDin and recording every action

chapters.title: Strict Judgment of Righteous Figures
chapters.about: examples involving Avraham Avinu, Yaakov Avinu, Yosef, and David HaMelech

summary: Rabbi Soffer reads through Chapter 4 of Mesillat Yesharim on how a person acquires Zehirut through Torah study and contemplating one's level of responsibility. He discusses the different levels of human motivation, from self-motivated perfectionists who fear sin to those driven by Kavod and Sakhar va'Onesh in Olam Haba. He also highlights transcript examples showing how Hashem is exacting with Hasidim, judging even the smallest oversights of Avraham Avinu, Yaakov Avinu, Yosef, and David HaMelech.

questions: How does learning Torah lead a person to become cautious and acquire Zehirut?
What motivates different personality types to strive for spiritual perfection?
How do feelings of honor and embarrassment manifest in Olam Haba?
Why is Hashem particularly strict and exacting in judging Hasidim?
For what specific actions were Avraham Avinu, Yaakov Avinu, and Yosef held accountable?
